approach: The x86_64 macOS binary is statically recompiled to C at build time and compiled for arm64; small native libraries replace Steam, Bink, Cg and the Intel-only parts.
help: Testing on other Apple Silicon Macs, especially 120 Hz ProMotion displays
Audio interfaces and inputs other than the Real Tone cable
Bug reports from long play sessions, DLC and custom songs
notes: Native arm64 build for Apple Silicon Macs, no Rosetta at run time. Builds from your own Steam copy with an installer; ships no game code. Offline by design (a network guard refuses every non-local connection). Gameplay CPU is about that of the original under Rosetta at 60 fps; the frame rate follows the display (75/120 Hz). Songs, DLC, custom songs, Session Mode and lessons work.
